description.narrative: Fair for All - Civic Space Activities - Year 5Supporting participation to the International Civil Society WeekThe next edition of International Civil Society Week (ICSW), the flagship event bringing togetherand celebrating global civil society, will be held 1-5 November 2025. CIVICUS and Asia DemocracyNetwork, the co-organizers, will hold the event in Bangkok. Theme: “Celebrating Citizen Action:Reimagining Democracy, Rights, and Inclusion for Today’s World”.We would like to participate in this initiativewith the support of the Oxfam Knowledge Hub onCivic Space and Active Citizenship.RATIONALE FOR F4A CIVIC SPACE TEAM PARTICIPATING TO ICSW:1. Enhancingvisibility of the F4A Program: The International Civil Society Week is a globalflagship event. Amitabh will be joining as key-note speaker for the event. Participating inICSW offers a strategic opportunity to showcase the F4A program’s contributions to civicspaceand inclusive, sustainable trade and value chains. It is an opportunity for raising itsprofileamong global civil society actors anddonors. The presence of the KH can alsocontribute to strengthening the Oxfam presence and increase our outreach.2. Sharing knowledge on Civic Space challenges, adaptive strategies and opportunities:The session will serve as a platform to share critical insights gathered throughout theprogram and in particular during the research and learning process finalized in Y5. Thetwo presentations by the KH on the Monitoring Tool and the work on Narratives, will alsocontribute to widening the exchange with partners and present otherexamples of work.Additionally, recommendations for external stakeholders and especially for futureprojects will be promoted.This convening will contribute to broader knowledge exchange on protectingandpromoting civic space in complex and rapidly evolving environments.3. Networking opportunity for F4A partners: ICSW provides a valuable space for F4Apartners to connect with peers and donors from across the globe. These interactions canfoster new collaborations and build momentum for continued advocacy and support forcivic space initiatives beyond the program.ACCEPTED CONCEPT NOTES:1) Title: Fair for All: Defending civic space for inclusive and sustainable trade and valuechainsScope: this session willshare finding of the F4A Civic Space research andrecommendations, space will be given to partners to share about their experienceand strategies.Who: 1 F4A Civic Space advisors (serving as facilitators/moderators) and2 F4Apartners (TBD, we will aim to ensure diversity among the consortium members andregions represented while also taking into account considerations around sensitivityand logistics)2) Title: The power of participatory civic spaces monitoring: Case studies from Oxfamand Plan InternationalScope: This session aims to spark dialogue on how civic space monitoring andanalysis can practically strengthen capacities, collective resilience and coordinatedaction to promote and protect democracy, rights and inclusion. The presentation willinclude examples on who monitoring has been incorporated into programs,mentioning the example of Fair for All baseline and end of project measurement.Who: KH Coordinator, Fair for All civic space knowledge broker, it will be done incollaboration with Plan International.3) Title: Building collective narrative power in contested spaces: Learning with andfrom narrative practitioners aroundthe worldScope: workshop will draw on combined insights and practical experiences onnarrative change work and aim at exploring how wecan leverage the power ofnarratives to reimagine and strengthen democracy, rights, and inclusionWho: KH Coordinator, Fair for All civic space knowledge broker, 1 Oxfam Partnerfrom Vietnam. The workshop will be done in collaboration with CIVICUSCommunicators for Civic Action Network.Note: this project was a pilot realised with the support of the ONL DevelopmentFund

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Intermón is since 1997 a member of the international Oxfam confederation, sharing values and a strategic plan to achieve greater global impact. Intermón Oxfam fights, with and for disadvantaged populations and as part of a broad global movement, with the aim of eradicating injustice and poverty, and to ensure that all human beings can fully exercise their rights and enjoy a dignified life. Mission, Vision and Values are the components of Oxfam Intermón identity and guide its steps as an organisation and the ideal with which Oxfam Intermón wants to live in order to obtain a fairer world with greater solidarity.
